initial_skills.name: step
initial_skills.source:
# step(to): one move toward point to; tries the longer axis first, then the other one
SET dx = to.x - here.x
SET dy = to.y - here.y
IF dx == 0 AND dy == 0
  RETURN "arrived"
END
SET ax = dx
IF dx < 0
  SET ax = 0 - dx
END
SET ay = dy
IF dy < 0
  SET ay = 0 - dy
END
SET h = "right"
IF dx < 0
  SET h = "left"
END
SET v = "up"
IF dy < 0
  SET v = "down"
END
SET first = h
SET second = v
IF ay > ax
  SET first = v
  SET second = h
END
SET m = move(first)
IF m.ok
  RETURN "moved"
END
SET m = move(second)
IF m.ok
  RETURN "moved"
END
RETURN "blocked"

initial_skills.name: goto
initial_skills.source:
# goto(to): walk to point to (up to 16 steps), no thinking cost while walking
SET stuck = 0
REPEAT 16
  CALL step(to) INTO s
  IF s == "arrived"
    RETURN "arrived"
  END
  IF s == "blocked"
    SET stuck = stuck + 1
    IF stuck >= 2
      RETURN "blocked on the way"
    END
  END
END
RETURN "still walking; run goto again"

initial_skills.name: feed
initial_skills.source:
# feed(): absorb compute from every fruit and residue on your own point; returns how many
SET r = observe(here)
IF NOT r.ok
  RETURN 0
END
SET got = 0
FOR_EACH e IN r.data.entities
  IF e.kind == "fruit" OR e.kind == "residue"
    SET a = absorb(e.id, "compute")
    IF a.ok
      SET got = got + 1
    END
  END
END
RETURN got

initial_skills.name: harvest
initial_skills.source:
# harvest(to): walk to point to, then absorb compute from all fruit and residue there
CALL goto(to) INTO g
IF g == "arrived"
  CALL feed() INTO n
  RETURN n
END
RETURN g
